styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Hero moments only: a title screen, a celebration.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Small headers, tabs on dense screens.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Plant seeds, wait a day, and come back to see what grew.
styles.usage: Long reading text. Bitbloom's body runs 2px larger than M3's for readability.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Default UI text. Never go smaller for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; list item inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margins.

tokens.name: pixel
tokens.usage: One art pixel. Borders, steps and shadows are multiples of it.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum size of anything tappable, including checkbox rows.

tokens.name: step-none
tokens.usage: Square: progress bars, dividers.

tokens.name: step-sm
tokens.usage: One-pixel corner notch. Default for every control: buttons, fields, chips, cards. Drawn by the pixel border, not border-radius.

tokens.name: step-lg
tokens.usage: Two-pixel stepped corner for large surfaces: dialogs, sheets. Cut with clip-path.

shadow.note: Elevation is a hard offset shadow with no blur, one art pixel per level.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Flat.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards, chips when dragged.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: FAB, snackbar, hovered card.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: M3 hover state layer.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: M3 focus state layer (always paired with focus-ring).

tokens.usage: M3 pressed state layer.
